title: Carrot Cake (server side)
description: The server side version of our "carrot cake" modpack.
body:
**Carrot Cake** – A light yet deeply flavorful *multiplayer* Minecraft modpack by **zachydabull** and **Calib**, now featuring **Create**, baked for players who savor simple things done right — especially together. Like its namesake, it’s familiar yet full of depth, crafted to be enjoyed in good company. *Carrot Cake* enhances the vanilla experience while keeping the essence of Minecraft intact, focusing on sustainability, exploration, and the joy of building a lasting world with friends.

With **140+ mods**, the pack refines visuals with Wakes on water and Continuity, breathes life into animals and bees, and smooths gameplay for seamless co-op adventures. Decorative expansions from Macaw’s catalog, new structures to explore, and vanilla-friendly tools like Tom’s Simple Storage make collaboration natural and satisfying.

Best experienced alongside your favorite terrain mods like **Biomes O’ Plenty** or **Terralith**, *Carrot Cake* shines brightest in multiplayer — a warm, balanced, endlessly replayable world meant to be shared.
